caption:
Six brokers, official APIs, zero browser scripts.

KaatDo operates as a server-side kill switch across six supported brokers: Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan, and Groww. Monitoring and execution run entirely through official trade APIs.

Keep your broker scope in mind. MCX commodity monitoring is beta on Fyers and Upstox, while Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan, and Groww are equity-only. Note that Groww provides no live unrealised P&L.

kaatdo.com

काट दो.

KaatDo is not investment advice and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
